title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 16 (DE) · „Gerade unterfüttert – und kann immer noch nicht essen“ – Kommentar-Antwort
format: Green-screen reply video: a dentist (cut out, chest-up) stands in the lower middle and answers a viewer comment, over photoreal B-roll of the woman who asked (kitchen table, dental practice, reception, car), lab close-ups of a denture on a plaster model, 3D jaw-ridge models on slate-blue, how-to close-ups and product shots. Many shots run without the dentist overlay.
voice_note: Male VO (the dentist), German, calm, clear, reassuring. Address: Sie.
captions_note: White bold sans with a soft black shadow, 2–4 words, centered in the middle. S01: white comment bubble top right (reply to a viewer comment). Dentist cut-out (extra asset Greenscreen-Dentist) lower middle in the scenes marked „+ Dentist overlay“. Green round 60-day badge top right in S53.

comment_card.text: Ich habe gerade erst eine weiche Unterfütterung bekommen und kann immer noch nicht essen. Meine Unterprothese wird ständig locker. Was mache ich jetzt?

shots.vo_line: können Sie das Material an die Form des Kieferkamms anpassen, den Sie jetzt gerade haben. Und
shots.h3_prompt: She holds the tube still, slowly opens her eyes and smiles with calm relief, breathing out, with small natural head movements; mouth closed; slight handheld. The tube keeps its exact shape and label, sharp and unchanged. One continuous shot from this exact first frame; keep the same people, faces, clothing, setting, background, lighting and colours for the whole clip. No new people, no extra hands. Nothing new enters the frame; the product's printed label stays exactly as in the first frame. Gentle natural motion, no morphing. She holds the tube still at chest height the whole time and does not move it toward the camera. Nothing new appears in the scene; every object and piece of clothing keeps its exact shape, colour and place.
